title: Green Horizon Officially Launched Under Erasmus+ Youth Programme
author: Consortium Secretariat
summary: Integrational e.V. (Germany), Yenilikçi Eğitim Bilim ve Sanat Derneği - IESA (Türkiye), and Asociatia Empower Plus (Romania) commence their 16-month Erasmus+ partnership.
content:
On 1 May 2025, the 'Green Horizon: Youth Voices for Climate Action Through Drone Technology' project officially began its implementation period under the Erasmus+ KA210-YOU Small-scale Partnerships in Youth scheme (Call 2024 Round 3, Form ID: KA210-YOU-AB0390DF).

Funded with a grant of €60,000 from the European Commission through the German National Agency (DE04 - JUGEND für Europa), the project will equip youth workers and young people aged 15-30 with cutting-edge skills in drone piloting, environmental photography, video post-production, and digital climate storytelling.

title: Consortium Meets in Bonn, Germany for Kick-Off Meeting (TPM 1)
author: Integrational e.V.
summary: Project coordinators, communication specialists, and key youth workers convene in Bonn to finalize work plans, the monitoring matrix, and training course logistics.
content:
Under Activity A1, representatives from Integrational e.V. (Germany), IESA (Türkiye), and Asociatia Empower Plus (Romania) gathered in Bonn for the two-day Kick-Off Transnational Project Meeting.

The consortium established its shared vision, confirmed the partner division of labor, adopted the bi-monthly monitoring framework, and finalized preparations for the upcoming summer training mobility in Romania.

title: Transnational Training Course: 18 Youth Workers to Train in Romania
author: Asociatia Empower Plus
summary: Curriculum finalized for the 6-day intensive training in Romania (11–16 August 2025), certifying 18 youth workers as drone flight and climate media facilitators.
content:
Asociatia Empower Plus has finalized the educational program for the Transnational Training Course for Youth Workers (Activity A2). Taking place in Romania from 11 to 16 August 2025, 18 youth workers (6 from each country) will receive hands-on training on drone setup, EASA Open Category safety rules, aerial photography, video editing, and non-formal pedagogical methods.

All participants will receive official Youthpass certificates recognizing their newly gained competences.

title: IESA Leads Drafting of Official Drone & Climate Mitigation Booklet
author: IESA Educational Team
summary: Development begins on the open-access 'Booklet on Drone Operation, Photography, and Effective Ways to Mitigate Climate Change' (Activity A3).
content:
Under the leadership of Yenilikçi Eğitim Bilim ve Sanat Derneği (IESA, Mersin), drafting of the core project booklet has commenced. The publication will feature three interconnected sections: technical drone operations, aerial photography and video storytelling, and practical climate mitigation strategies.

The booklet will be made available as a free Open Access digital download translated into English, German, Turkish, and Romanian.

title: Official Project Web Platform greenhorizonyou.eu Deployed
author: Web Operations Team
summary: The central dissemination platform for Green Horizon goes live at https://greenhorizonyou.eu, built to WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards.
content: The official Green Horizon web portal is now live under Activity A6. Serving as the dissemination hub for the project, the platform features an interactive Europe consortium map, a 360-degree VR demonstration viewer, and open-access repositories for educational downloads and upcoming documentary films.
